slot.archetype: para jumble (5 sentences, find the first sentence)
slot.brief: Four sentence options given for the opening of a short paragraph on a general topic; pick the most coherent opener.

stem:
Arrange the following sentences into a coherent paragraph. Which sentence should come first?

P. As a result, many households now grow herbs and vegetables in containers.
Q. Urban gardening has become a practical way to bring greenery into crowded neighbourhoods.
R. Even a small balcony can provide enough room for a few pots.
S. These plants can also make fresh ingredients readily available.
T. With regular watering and sunlight, they are easy to maintain.

verdicts.working: Q introduces the topic; the other sentences depend on ideas or references introduced later.

working:
Q introduces the topic. R gives a specific example; T’s “they” refers to the pots/plants, followed by P’s “As a result” and S’s “These plants”. Q is the only broad introductory sentence.

Independent check: Q introduces the topic; the other sentences depend on ideas or references introduced later.
solution: Q introduces the broad topic of urban gardening, while the other sentences provide examples or refer back to plants and pots introduced later.
